name: CanvasMC
author: gobiadactyl@gobia.cloud
description: CanvasMC, a Folia fork with region threading (Gobiadactyl fork).

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Gobiadactyl artifact installer: pinned GitHub release asset or direct URL, optional SHA-256 check.
set -eu
apk add --no-cache curl jq >/dev/null
mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) ARCH=amd64; ARCH_UP=X64 ;;
  aarch64) ARCH=arm64; ARCH_UP=ARM64 ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported CPU architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac
TARGET="${SERVER_JARFILE}"
AUTH=""
[ -n "${ARTIFACT_TOKEN:-}" ] && AUTH="Authorization: Bearer ${ARTIFACT_TOKEN}"

if [ -n "${ARTIFACT_URL:-}" ]; then
  URL="$ARTIFACT_URL"; TAG="${ARTIFACT_TAG:-direct}"; ACCEPT="*/*"
else
  [ -n "${ARTIFACT_REPO:-}" ] || { echo "Set ARTIFACT_REPO (owner/name) and ARTIFACT_TAG, or ARTIFACT_URL."; exit 1; }
  API="https://api.github.com/repos/${ARTIFACT_REPO}/releases"
  if [ "${ARTIFACT_TAG:-latest}" = "latest" ]; then REL="$API/latest"
  else REL="$API/tags/$(printf %s "$ARTIFACT_TAG" | jq -sRr @uri)"; fi
  JSON=$(curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" ${AUTH:+-H "$AUTH"} "$REL") \
    || { echo "Release not found: ${ARTIFACT_REPO} ${ARTIFACT_TAG:-latest}"; exit 1; }
  TAG=$(echo "$JSON" | jq -r .tag_name)
  VERSION=${TAG#v}
  PATTERN=$(printf %s "$ARTIFACT_ASSET" | sed -e "s/{arch}/$ARCH/g" -e "s/{ARCH}/$ARCH_UP/g" -e "s/{version}/$VERSION/g")
  URL=$(echo "$JSON" | jq -r --arg p "$PATTERN" '[.assets[] | select(.name | test("^" + $p + "$"))][0].url // empty')
  [ -n "$URL" ] || { echo "No asset matching ^${PATTERN}\$ in ${ARTIFACT_REPO} ${TAG}"; echo "$JSON" | jq -r '.assets[].name'; exit 1; }
  ACCEPT="application/octet-stream"
fi

echo "Downloading ${TAG} -> ${TARGET}"
curl -fL --retry 3 -H "Accept: $ACCEPT" ${AUTH:+-H "$AUTH"} -o "${TARGET}.download" "$URL"
SUM=$(sha256sum "${TARGET}.download" | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ -n "${ARTIFACT_SHA256:-}" ] && [ "$SUM" != "$(echo "$ARTIFACT_SHA256" | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')" ]; then
  rm -f "${TARGET}.download"; echo "SHA-256 mismatch: got $SUM, expected $ARTIFACT_SHA256"; exit 1
fi
[ -f "$TARGET" ] && mv -f "$TARGET" "${TARGET}.previous"
mv "${TARGET}.download" "$TARGET"
[ -f server.properties ] || printf "server-port=25565\nserver-ip=0.0.0.0\n" > server.properties
printf 'source=%s\ntag=%s\nsha256=%s\ninstalled_at=%s\n' "${ARTIFACT_URL:-$ARTIFACT_REPO}" "$TAG" "$SUM" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > .gobia-artifact
echo "Installed ${TAG} (sha256 ${SUM})"

variables.name: Artifact repository
variables.description: GitHub repository (owner/name) whose release holds the build. Point it at your fork.

variables.name: Release tag
variables.description: Pinned release tag to install (reinstall to change it). 'latest' follows the newest release; avoid it in production.

variables.name: Release asset pattern
variables.description: Jar asset name in the release. Regex, anchored; {arch} = amd64/arm64, {ARCH} = X64/ARM64, {version} = tag without a leading v.

variables.name: Direct download URL
variables.description: Overrides the repository and tag: download this URL instead.

variables.name: Expected SHA-256
variables.description: Optional. The install fails if the download does not match.

variables.name: GitHub token (private repos)
variables.description: Optional read-only token (Contents: read) for a private release. Admin only.

variables.name: Server jar file
variables.description: File the build is saved as and started from.

variables.name: Max RAM percent
variables.description: Heap limit as a share of the container memory.

variables.name: JVM flags
variables.description: Extra JVM flags (default: Aikar's G1 flags).

variables.name: server.properties path
variables.description: Path of server.properties. The panel sets the port only in ./server.properties.

variables.name: Paper config directory
variables.description: Directory with paper-global.yml, paper-world-defaults.yml and the fork's own config files.

variables.name: Extra server arguments
variables.description: Appended to the server command line.
